descriptor: Reservation attribution pilot and Tock measurement readiness
status: Attribution pilot foundation delivered; live paid-media spend and booking attribution are not yet connected
signal: August produced the live Puttery NYC attribution dashboard, two client-ready pilot PDFs, the kickoff and access packet, and the Tock reservation-data implementation specification. No verified Puttery ad-spend source is currently mapped.
goal: Secure the exact Puttery NYC platform access and Tock event route, then validate booking attribution before any live campaign feedback or spend claim.
work: Published the Puttery-branded attribution pilot dashboard with the seven-system measurement map.
Delivered the Attribution Pilot Brief and Discovery Blocker Worksheet with the exact official logo.
Completed the kickoff analysis, day-zero access packet, execution plan, and two-and-a-half-week build monitor.
Prepared the Tock reservation-event intake specification and the acceptance criteria for the NYC pilot.
analysis: Puttery entered August as an attribution and measurement build, not a verified paid-media reporting account. The delivered dashboard and discovery package make the remaining access and data decisions explicit.
The local booking-event intake path is ready for controlled validation, but production activation still depends on exact Tock, analytics, ad-account, consent, venue-isolation, and hosting decisions.

platforms.name: Attribution pilot
platforms.note: The dashboard covers the website layer, Tock, Toast, Tripleseat, analytics, Google Ads, and Meta, with 64 discovery questions and 43 identified blockers. Demonstration data is not presented as live performance.

platforms.name: Booking attribution readiness
platforms.note: The NYC booking-event specification and acceptance criteria are prepared. Production use waits on exact account binding, permissions, consent, location isolation, and hosting ownership.

outcome.platform: No verified Puttery Google Ads or Meta spend source is mapped for August, so no media-performance total is claimed.
outcome.business: The dashboard, discovery materials, kickoff package, and reservation-attribution foundation were delivered during August.
outcome.measurement: Connect exact Tock and analytics evidence, validate two venue-days, and confirm the primary booking outcome before activating production reporting.

detailedWork: Creates one shared view of the measurement system.
Sets the production sequence and responsibilities.
Makes booking attribution testable once access is approved.
wins: The pilot dashboard and client discovery package are complete.
The booking-attribution path now has explicit acceptance criteria and ownership gates.
augustFocus: Secure exact Tock, analytics, and ad-account access for Puttery NYC.
Validate booking events and two venue-days before production activation.
nextMoves: Approve exact platform owners, access, consent, and NYC isolation.
Reconcile two venue-days against Tock booking evidence.
Move from demonstration to production reporting only after the validation gate passes.

leadAccounting: Platform activity is reported separately from qualified inquiries, appointments, estimates, bookings, and revenue. Conversion reporting remains pending validation wherever the exact action definition, attribution window, or downstream outcome is not fully reconciled.
